Inicio con la afiliación de taxistas a la aplicación para poder crecer a manager de equipo de ventas, supervisando al equipo, especialmente en zonas complicadas de la ciudad. Atención al cliente, organización y coordinación del equipo.

receivedRecommendations.givenByHeadline: Country Director | Delivery | Marketing | Trade Marketing | AI & Automation 🤖| Product & IT | Management | Sales Leadership, CRM, Driving growth through Ops and CS expertise
receivedRecommendations.givenAt: March 11, 2025, Marcos Fernando was senior to María del Mar but didn't manage María del Mar directly
receivedRecommendations.description:
I had the privilege of working closely with Maria del Mar Gutierrez since the early days of Carryt, and her contribution has been nothing short of extraordinary. As our Supply Leader, Maria has played a pivotal role in building and expanding our driver fleet, becoming a cornerstone of the company's growth.

Her ability to develop acquisition strategies, establish solid recruitment processes, and foster strong relationships with our crowdsourcing drivers has been essential in ensuring the success of key projects. Thanks to her leadership, we've not only met our operational demands but have also created a scalable and sustainable model for fleet growth.

Maria's proactive mindset, combined with her dedication and deep understanding of logistics, has allowed us to expand into new territories and successfully manage seasonal peaks like Buen Fin and Hot Sale. Her ability to align driver acquisition efforts with our strategic goals has been a major factor in achieving our delivery targets.

Beyond her technical skills, Maria stands out as a committed and collaborative leader who inspires her team to deliver their best. Her positive attitude, resilience, and focus on continuous improvement make her an invaluable asset to any organization.

I wholeheartedly recommend Maria for any role that requires strategic thinking, leadership, and operational excellence. Any team would be fortunate to have her on board.

receivedRecommendations.givenAt: February 25, 2025, Cristian managed María del Mar directly
receivedRecommendations.description:
Trabajar con Maria del Mar ha sido una gran experiencia. Su conocimiento y experiencia en la adquisición de flota han sido clave para optimizar nuestras operaciones, logrando procesos más eficientes y costos estratégicamente controlados.

Su habilidad para negociar con proveedores, analizar tendencias del mercado y tomar decisiones informadas han marcado una diferencia significativa en nuestro equipo. Además, su compromiso, proactividad y enfoque en la mejora continua hacen que sea un referente en su área.

Sin duda, Maria del Mar es un gran profesional y un activo invaluable para cualquier organización que busque optimizar la gestión de flota y logística.
